slides.title: Every switch *costs something.*
slides.sub: What research on task switching found.

slides.title: Switching takes time
slides.body: In one study, people lost time every time they switched from one task to another. Harder tasks cost more.

slides.title: The brain resets
slides.body: Researchers describe two steps: shifting the goal, then turning off the old task's rules and turning on the new ones.

slides.title: Small costs add up
slides.body: One switch may take a few tenths of a second. Going back and forth all day adds up, with more mistakes.

slides.title: Try one thing at a time
slides.body: Pick what matters most right now. Notice each time you reach to switch. What were you about to leave?
